crossRefs.note: Yahweh says, “What unrighteousness have your fathers found in me, that they have gone far from me, and have walked…
Indeed all the nations may walk in the name of their gods; but we will walk in the name of Yahweh our God forever and…
knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed…
Should a man make to himself gods which yet are no gods?”
Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore…
Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that…
The priests didn’t say, ‘Where is Yahweh?’ and those who handle the law didn’t know me. The rulers also transgressed…
You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your…
But you, Yahweh, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.
Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.
and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds…

translations.web: Has a nation changed its gods, which really are no gods? But my people have changed their glory for that which doesn’t profit.
translations.bsb: Has a nation ever changed its gods? (Yet they are not gods at all.) But My people have exchanged their Glory for useless idols.
translations.kjv: Hath a nation changed their gods, which are yet no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
translations.asv: Hath a nation changed its gods, which yet are no gods? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit.
